## Professional Work (Adobe, 2021–Present)

### Brand Concierge (2024–Present)
Enterprise-grade agentic AI conversational platform built from 0→1. Multiple specialized AI agents that orchestrate intelligent, on-brand conversations at scale. Responsible AI controls including brand guardrails and human-in-the-loop escalation. Deployed for Fortune 500 companies across financial services, hospitality, and technology verticals.
URL: https://business.adobe.com/products/brand-concierge.html

### Sales Qualifier (2024–Present)
AI agent for Sales Development Representatives — autonomously handles account research, email drafting, outbound outreach, and CRM updates. Collapsed 9-step SDR workflows to 3. Rapid enterprise adoption within first 3 months.
URL: https://business.adobe.com/products/journey-optimizer-b2b-edition/sales-qualification.html

### Dynamic Chat (2022–Present)
Adobe's GenAI-powered conversational platform for enterprise marketing and sales. Envisioned, launched, and scaled to 1000+ enterprise customers. Led cross-functional teams across engineering, design, GTM, and legal. Drove monetization strategy and trust/compliance controls.
URL: https://business.adobe.com/products/marketo/dynamic-chat.html

### Content AI Assistant (2023–2024)
GenAI-powered email content design tool for enterprise marketers. Delivered billions of customer engagements in its first year. Used by 2000+ enterprises.

### Predictive Audiences (2019–2021, GlobalLogic/Marketo acquired by Adobe)
AI/ML capabilities for marketing audience scoring and targeting. Influenced hundreds of enterprise deals. Gartner mention in 2020. Built Email Bot Activity Detection system that identified 100M+ bot activities with a 3-person team. 55% feature adoption within 100 days.

## Startup Experience

### GetMeAShop (Co-Founder, 2013–2015)
One of 4 founding team members. Built an all-in-one B2B SaaS platform for small businesses from zero to 20,000+ customers across India. Grew company from 4 to 105 team members.

### Times Internet / GetMeAShop (Product Lead, 2015–2019)
Post-acquisition product leadership. Owned eCommerce, POS, social commerce, and affiliate integrations. Grew platform to multi-million dollar annual revenue.

## Personal Projects (Nights & Weekends)

### CatchUp (2025)
Android app unifying curated publications and friends' shared content into one AI-powered feed. Features RSS aggregation, friends' shared content from WhatsApp/Telegram/Instagram, smart collections, Ask AI, and multi-LLM support (Grok, Gemini, OpenAI, Perplexity, Anthropic).
Details: https://sree-kanth.netlify.app/catchup.html

### PM Skills Pack (2025)
16 AI agent skills for Claude Code and Cursor covering the full product management workflow loop. Phases: Discover → Define → Build & Ship → Operate. Built to create shared product intelligence across PM teams. Saves ~2 hours per exec review cycle.
Details: https://sree-kanth.netlify.app/pm-skills.html

### BookInShorts (2025)
Android app that converts any PDF into swipeable AI-generated summary cards (30 seconds per card) with audio narration. Supports Gemini, Claude, GPT-4, and local Ollama models. Zero telemetry, fully private.
URL: https://bookinshorts.netlify.app/

### Doit (2025)
Web app for AI-powered group decision making. Pick a category (movies, food, restaurants, weekend getaways), get AI suggestions from 4 LLM providers (Perplexity, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama Cloud), and swipe-vote with friends until everyone agrees. Real-time consensus detection, activity expiry, mark-as-decided. No install required.
URL: https://lets-lockin.netlify.app/

### Vottery (2025)
Gamified secondary marketplace using coupon-based lottery mechanics. Sellers list unused items at full price; buyers win at a fraction of the cost. UPI payments, live draw, Android + PWA.
Details: https://sree-kanth.netlify.app/vottery.html

### Content Modes (2025)
LLM-powered drop-in widget that transforms any marketing page into 4 adaptive reading modes: Verbose, Quick Read, Visual, and Audio. Built for enterprise marketers to serve diverse reader preferences.
Details: https://sree-kanth.netlify.app/content-modes.html

## Product Philosophy
- Excellence = User Value + Business Impact + Team Growth
- "Use AI where it creates magic. Use rules where it creates reliability."
- Agentic-first thinking: design for orchestration and autonomy from day one
- Hill-climbing on probabilistic products: ship fast, measure relentlessly
- Responsible AI as a first-class metric: trust and fairness are launch criteria
- Inclusive product thinking: the best products serve the widest range of users
- Cross-functional influence over authority
